opportunities.name: Tech project lead note (HN + GitHub)
opportunities.description: For a given tech project, find its Hacker News top story and points, check its GitHub repo stars and latest release, then save a Lead note in notes.
steps: Search project name on Hacker News (or Algolia)
Note top story title, points, age
Search project name on GitHub and open the top repo
Read stars and last release date
Open notes, click New note, type 'Lead: <project>. HN ... GitHub ...' and press Enter

opportunities.name: Country fact-check note (World Bank + BBC)
opportunities.description: For a country, look up indicator data on World Bank, search BBC news for related topic, and save a fact-check note.
steps: Search the country in World Bank data search
Search BBC for '<country> <topic>' and open top article
Add a note with the fact and news context
